Composition API: onBeforeMount().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onBeforeMount } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a hook to be called right before the component is to be mounted.

Composition API: onMounted().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onMounted } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a callback to be called after the component has been mounted.

Composition API: onBeforeUpdate().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onBeforeUpdate } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a hook to be called right before the component is about to update its DOM tree due to a reactive state change.

Composition API: onUpdated().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onUpdated } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a callback to be called after the component has updated its DOM tree due to a reactive state change.

Composition API: onBeforeUnmount().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Maps to the `beforeDestroy` option in Vue 2.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a hook to be called right before a component instance is to be unmounted.

Composition API: onUnmounted().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onUnmounted } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Maps to the `destroyed` option in Vue 2.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a callback to be called after the component has been unmounted.

Composition API: onErrorCaptured().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onErrorCaptured } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a hook to be called when an error propagating from a descendant component has been captured.

Composition API: onRenderTracked().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onRenderTracked } from 'vue'`). Dev only.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a debug hook to be called when a reactive dependency has been tracked by the component's render effect.

Composition API: onRenderTriggered().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onRenderTriggered } from 'vue'`). Dev only.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a debug hook to be called when a reactive dependency triggers the component's render effect to be re-run.

Composition API: onActivated().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onActivated } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a callback to be called after the component instance is inserted into the DOM as part of a tree cached by `<keep-alive>`.

Composition API: onDeactivated().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onDeactivated } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers a callback to be called after the component instance is removed from the DOM as part of a tree cached by `<keep-alive>`.

Composition API: onServerPrefetch().description:
Vue 2.7+ (`import { onServerPrefetch } from 'vue'`). SSR only.
Composition API: Lifecycle Hooks.
Registers an async function to be resolved before the component instance is to be rendered on the server.

Composition API: async onBeforeMount().description: Vue 2.7+ (`import { onBeforeMount } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.

Composition API: async onMounted().description: Vue 2.7+ (`import { onMounted } from 'vue'`), or the [@vue/composition-api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@vue/composition-api) plugin on Vue 2.6 and below.
